The '''Gordunni Outpost'''{{co|75|35|Feralas}} is an area in the mountains north of [[Lariss Pavilion]] currently held by the [[Gordunni]] [[ogre]]s.  Their presence has wilted the normally verdant plant life of [[Feralas]] into a withered brown.

The hills have two caves, a small one towards the entrance and an [[ogre mound]] at the back of the area.

[[Gordunni Ogre]]s, [[Gordunni Ogre Mage]]s and [[Gordunni Brute]]s roam the area.
